news.n: Blue Cross Medicaid plans in Illinois and Texas move NEMT from Modivcare to MTM; New Mexico follows Nov. 1
news.src: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Texas
news.sum: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Illinois and of Texas (STAR, CHIP, STAR Kids) switched Medicaid NEMT from Modivcare to MTM Health on Oct. 1. Blue Cross of New Mexico makes the same switch Nov. 1. If you ran those members' trips through Modivcare, that volume now runs through MTM's network.

news.n: Colorado reopens NEMT provider enrollment; every trip runs through MediDrive from Jan. 1
news.sum: Colorado's NEMT enrollment moratorium ended Sept. 30, so new providers can enroll again from Oct. 1. Starting Jan. 1, 2027, all NEMT trips statewide are scheduled, approved and paid through MediDrive. Contract with MediDrive under the exact business name and NPI you used to enroll with Health First Colorado.

news.n: Oregon NEMT owner sentenced for billing rides for a patient who had died
news.sum: The owner of Portland's Pride Transit pleaded guilty to two felony false-claim counts for billing transportation for a person who had died. Sentence: 36 months probation, $6,420 restitution, a $5,000 fine and a permanent bar from Medicaid-funded businesses.

news.n: Colorado cuts NEMT ambulatory base rate from $36.40 to $12.15; providers shed staff ahead of statewide broker
news.sum: Colorado's July 1 change took ambulatory trips from $36.40 to $12.15 and per-mile pay from $3.00 to $2.74. One Colorado Springs provider laid off 15 people and dropped from about 115 families to 80. A single statewide broker takes over by January 2027, with rideshare as the provider of last resort.

news.n: Fuel costs squeeze Ohio NEMT operators on fixed Medicaid rates
news.sum: Toledo-area provider Golden Care Transportation told WTOL that rising fuel prices are eating into trips paid at fixed reimbursement rates. On a fixed per-trip rate, every fuel increase comes straight out of your margin.

news.n: SafeRide Health marks ten years in NEMT
news.sum: The tech-first broker put out a ten-year recap this week. Worth reading for the plan-partner list if you are deciding which broker portals to credential with next.

news.n: Modivcare names Marshalina Ramos CEO of Personal Care Services
news.sum: Leadership shuffle at the largest NEMT broker's personal-care arm. No change announced on the transportation side yet.

news.n: Provide A Ride sold to 1585 Healthcare Capital
news.sum: The Cleveland NEMT and paratransit operator, 100-plus vehicles and 500-plus employees since 1989, was acquired by healthcare investor 1585 Healthcare Capital in a deal advised by Kroll. Another sign that mid-size regional fleets are drawing PE money.

news.n: Crown Care NEMT launches nationwide private-pay booking with two-hour confirmation
news.sum: A national private-pay play with a two-hour booking promise. If it holds, it sets a service bar local operators will get compared against by discharge planners.

cats.h1: NEMT Software: Dispatch, Scheduling and Billing Platforms
cats.intro: Dispatch and scheduling platforms, broker portal integrations, driver apps and billing tools built for non-emergency medical transportation. Compare vendors that serve NEMT fleets, from single-van startups to multi-state operators.

cats.h1: NEMT Billing and Revenue Cycle Management
cats.intro: Claims submission, broker reconciliation, denial management and outsourced billing for NEMT providers. These firms handle the paperwork between a completed trip and a paid invoice.

The transportation brokers, managed care organizations and state Medicaid programs that assign trips and pay providers. Use this list to find who to credential with in your state and read our broker report card before you sign.

cats.h1: NEMT Trip Networks and Rideshare Platforms
cats.intro: The platforms that route rides from hospitals, health plans and brokers to rideshare drivers and NEMT fleets, plus the assisted-mobility rideshare networks. Use this list to find who else sends trips besides your broker and how to join their provider network.

Startup consultants, licensing and credentialing help, driver training programs and compliance coaches for NEMT businesses. Vet credentials carefully; the bar to call yourself a consultant in this industry is low.

cats.h1: NEMT Vehicles and Wheelchair Van Upfitting
cats.intro: Wheelchair-accessible vans, ambulatory minivans, stretcher vehicles and the upfitters and dealers who build them to ADA and state specifications. Includes new, used and conversion specialists.

cats.h1: NEMT Stretchers, Wheelchairs and Securement Equipment
cats.intro: Stretchers and cots, transport wheelchairs, and the securement that holds them in the van: wheelchair tie-downs, occupant restraints and stretcher mounts, plus the lifts and ramps that get passengers on board.

cats.h1: NEMT Dash Cameras, GPS and Telematics
cats.intro: AI dash cameras, GPS tracking, driver safety scoring, vehicle inspection apps and the fleet data platforms NEMT operators use to protect drivers, riders and insurance rates.

Commercial auto, general liability, professional liability and workers' compensation carriers and brokers who write non-emergency medical transportation. Coverage is the largest fixed cost after payroll for most fleets, so shop it every renewal.
Lenders, lessors and factoring companies that fund wheelchair vans, fleet expansion and the cash-flow gap between completed trips and broker payment.

cats.h1: Fuel Cards, Maintenance and Fleet Services for NEMT
cats.intro: Fuel card programs, preventive maintenance networks, tire and roadside programs, and fleet management services that keep NEMT vehicles on the road and deadhead costs down.
Card processing, private-pay collection, driver pay tools and embedded finance products built for transportation providers.

cats.h1: Marketing and Web Services for NEMT Providers
cats.intro: Agencies and freelancers who build websites, run local search and handle lead generation for NEMT providers competing for private-pay and facility contracts.

cats.h1: NEMT Associations, Regulators and Government Programs
cats.intro: Industry associations, state Medicaid transportation offices, licensing agencies and federal programs that shape how non-emergency medical transportation is regulated and paid.

cats.h1: NEMT Staffing, Driver Recruiting and Background Checks
cats.intro: Driver recruiting platforms, staffing agencies, background check and drug screening providers, and PEOs that serve transportation companies.
Vendors that serve NEMT operators but do not fit a single category above, from uniform suppliers to translation services.
